release_notes:
LightClicker v1.1.1 update log:
• Added professional Saved Positions mode.
• Added multiple click points in one list.
• Added Cycle All mode to rotate through saved positions.
• Added Selected Only mode to click one saved point.
• Added easier Click Location names: Follow Mouse, Type Coordinates, Choose From Screen, Saved Positions.
• Added visible saved-position controls: ADD, CHOOSE, DELETE, CLEAR.
• Added cleaner update notification with change logs.
• Added first-run update log after installing.
• Improved installer flow: Welcome, License, Start Menu Folder, Additional Tasks, Ready to Install, Install, Finish.
• Improved icon handling for title bar, taskbar, installer, and shortcuts.
• Improved website motion speed and smoothness.
• Bug fixes and stability checks for click modes, hotkeys, and CPS input.
